summary: Restore a backup's pre-migration history that a later membership claim keys from its first sequence

replay.detail: Claim replay and projections are unchanged. Restore admits the same archived envelopes the source admitted, then replays them as before.

schema.detail: No schema, index or trigger change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and live fleet admission are unchanged; members need no coordinated upgrade.

compatibility.detail: No API, protocol or archive format change.

recovery.detail: Backup restore no longer holds archived envelopes as unsigned or fenced by membership claims replayed ahead of them in writer order, because an archive holds only envelopes its source admitted. A restore of a database written by v0.3.17 or earlier that failed with 'backup contains N unadmitted envelopes' (a member migrated without a writer floor, whose pre-migration envelopes were relayed unsigned) now succeeds and can simply be run again; restores that already succeeded produce the same log.
